problem_statement: Build a 6-hourly ETL pipeline that scrapes rental listings from five Korean-language community boards (svkoreans, gtksa, missyusa/town9, ktown.koreadaily, m.radiokorea; hanintown disabled placeholder), normalizes Korean price/date/location formats into a bilingual schema, deduplicates listings across sources, and loads them into Postgres. Solo-dev Docker Compose deployment, conservative scraping posture, test-driven.

test_strategy: unit tests with stored HTML fixtures per source
integration tests against ephemeral postgres+redis via docker-compose.test.yml
DAG-import smoke tests via `airflow dags test`

crawl_policy.detail_pages: only when URL is new (Redis miss) OR content hash differs

background_research_decisions.html_samples: captured during scraper implementation as test fixtures
background_research_decisions.redis_role: dedup cache (separate from any Airflow needs)
background_research_decisions.nominatim_policy: 1 req/sec, custom User-Agent, results cached in Redis 30d

tables.purpose: Per-run logs with row counts, errors, duration

tasks.title: Project skeleton, tooling, and CI-equivalent local checks
tasks.objective: Stand up an empty but fully-tooled Python project so every subsequent task can be developed test-first.
guidance: Initialize uv project (Python 3.11) with placeholder deps for scrapling, psycopg, redis, rapidfuzz, pyyaml, pydantic, click, apache-airflow.
Configure ruff (lint+format), mypy --strict, pytest with pytest-cov, pre-commit.
Create directory skeleton with __init__.py and a placeholder cli.py exposing --version.
Add Makefile with targets: lint, typecheck, test, test-integration, ci, smoke.
tasks.demo: `make ci` runs ruff+mypy+pytest green on a fresh clone; `python -m korean_rental_etl.cli --version` prints a version string.

tasks.title: Source registry, config loader, and FetcherSelector
tasks.objective: Encode all 6 sources in YAML and provide a typed loader plus a fetcher factory.
guidance: config/sources.yml lists all sources with name, url, path, fetcher, schedule, download_delay, concurrent_requests, robots_txt_obey, status.
SourceConfig Pydantic model + load_sources() loader.
FetcherSelector.for_source(cfg) returns Scrapling fetcher pre-configured with stealth options + delays + retry/backoff.
tasks.demo: `cli sources list` prints active/disabled sources from YAML; `sources show svkoreans` prints resolved config.

tasks.title: Postgres schema migrations + Docker Compose dev stack
tasks.objective: Provide reproducible schemas, indexes, extensions, and a working dev DB.
guidance: SQL migrations creating raw/staging/public/audit schemas and the 5 tables with bilingual columns.
8 indexes on public.listings including GiST on geo_point and GIN pg_trgm on (title_ko, body_ko, address_raw).
docker-compose.yml: postgres (init script creates Airflow + app DBs, enables pg_trgm + postgis), redis.
docker-compose.test.yml on different ports.
db/connection.py psycopg pool from env vars.
tests: tests/integration/db/test_schema.py spins up test compose, runs migrations, asserts tables/indexes/extensions exist
tasks.demo: `docker compose up -d postgres redis && make test-integration` green; psql shows all tables.

tasks.title: Raw-HTML writer + audit-run record + Redis URL cache (dedup layer 1)
tasks.objective: Persist fetched HTML idempotently, log every run, and short-circuit re-fetches.
guidance: raw_writer.save(...) writes raw.scraped_pages with ON CONFLICT (source_id, url, content_hash) DO NOTHING.
audit.start_run/finish_run lifecycle helpers.
redis_layer.seen(url)/mark(url) per-source SET with TTL=14d.
tests: integration: writer roundtrip, audit lifecycle, redis seen/mark
tasks.demo: `cli demo write-raw --source svkoreans --html-file …` inserts a row; rerun is a no-op.

tasks.title: First source extractor — svkoreans (walking-skeleton scraper)
tasks.objective: Prove the extract path end-to-end with a real Cloudflare-protected source.
guidance: BaseScraper ABC: crawl_list_pages(), fetch_detail(url), shared retry/backoff/ban-detection.
scrapers/svkoreans.py uses StealthyFetcher with solve_cloudflare=True.
Capture ≥3 list + ≥5 detail HTML samples into tests/fixtures/html/svkoreans/.
Detail-page gating: fetch only on Redis-miss OR list-summary content-hash change.
Wire to raw_writer + audit + redis layer.
tests: unit on link extraction with fixtures
integration runs extractor against fixtures (no network) and asserts raw rows
tasks.demo: `cli extract --source svkoreans` populates raw.scraped_pages; second run only inserts new pages.

tasks.title: Remaining four extractors — gtksa, missyusa, ktown_koreadaily, radiokorea
tasks.objective: Complete the Extract phase across all 5 active sources.
guidance: Repeat Task 5 pattern for each source; radiokorea uses DynamicFetcher per its config.
Capture HTML fixtures (≥3 list, ≥5 detail) per source.
Add `extract --all` CLI iterating active sources sequentially with per-source delays.
tests: test_extract_all runs all four against fixtures
tasks.demo: `cli extract --all` populates raw.scraped_pages for all 5 sources; reruns idempotent. Extract phase complete.

tasks.title: Per-source HTML parsers → staging.listings_staging + content-hash dedup (layer 2)
tasks.objective: Turn raw HTML into structured bilingual rows and skip unchanged content.
guidance: transform/parsers/<source>.py with Scrapling adaptive selectors (auto_save=True).
Parsers emit {title_ko, body_ko, raw_price, raw_location, raw_posted_at, contact_block, source_listing_id, url, content_hash}.
hash_layer skips rows whose content_hash already exists in staging for the same source.
CLI: `transform parse` reads unparsed raw rows → staging rows.
tests: golden-file tests per source (HTML in, dict out)
tasks.demo: `cli transform parse` produces staging rows for all 5 sources; rerun produces zero new rows.

tasks.title: Normalizers — price, date, location, contact
tasks.objective: Convert Korean raw fields into bilingual normalized columns.
guidance: price.py: 월세/보증금/전세/단기/리스 + USD/KRW → {rent_monthly_usd, deposit_usd, lease_type, currency_raw, price_raw_ko}.
date.py: 2024년 5월 1일 / 오늘 / 어제 / 방금 전 / ~까지 → ISO-8601 posted_at_utc.
location.py: address_raw → {city, state_or_province, country} with US/Canada/KR detection.
contact.py: regex-extract phone, kakao_id, email; plaintext.
Failures land in errors JSONB without crashing the run.
tests: table-driven unit tests per normalizer with KO/EN/edge cases (≥80% coverage)
tasks.demo: `transform parse` outputs staging rows with bilingual + normalized fields populated.

tasks.title: Nominatim geocoder with Redis caching + rate limit
tasks.objective: Geocode addresses politely and cheaply; tolerate failures.
guidance: geocoder.py: input (address_raw, city, country); SHA1-keyed Redis cache TTL 30d.
1 req/sec global token bucket; custom User-Agent from env.
Failures leave lat/lon NULL and log to audit errors.
Writes geo_point (PostGIS) on staging rows.
tests: integration against test redis with stubbed responses
tasks.demo: `transform geocode` enriches resolvable addresses with lat/lon; second run hits cache only.

tasks.title: Category classifier (rule-based KO+EN keywords)
tasks.objective: Tag every listing with one of the 9 English category labels.
guidance: classifier.py: bilingual keyword dict → {apartment, house, condo, room_share, sublet, roommate_wanted, commercial_space, parking, other}.
Multi-match → priority order; unmatched → 'other'.
tests: parameterized unit tests covering every category from KO and EN inputs and ambiguous cases
tasks.demo: `transform classify` populates category on every staging row; CLI prints distribution.

tasks.title: Cross-source fuzzy dedup (layer 3) + canonicalization
tasks.objective: Collapse the same listing posted on multiple boards into one canonical record.
guidance: fuzzy_layer.py with RapidFuzz: blocking by (±7d posted_at, normalized_city); token-set similarity on f'{title} {price}' ≥ 0.90.
Group matches; canonical = source-priority + earliest posted_at; mark others duplicate_of.
tests: unit tests with synthetic listings posted on 2-3 boards: clear positives, near-misses, time-window edges
tasks.demo: `transform dedup` collapses cross-source duplicates; CLI prints duplicates/canonicals counts. Transform phase complete.

tasks.title: Loader — batch upsert into public.listings with audit
tasks.objective: Move clean staging rows into the final table idempotently.
guidance: upserter.py: per-batch INSERT … ON CONFLICT (source_id, source_listing_id) DO UPDATE in a single transaction; batch size 500.
Updates last_seen_at, is_active=true; records counts in audit.etl_runs.
CLI: `load run` consumes staging rows where loaded_at IS NULL.
tests: partial-batch failure rolls back batch and continues
tasks.demo: `cli run-all` performs full extract→transform→load against fixtures; pg_trgm FTS query returns expected hits. Load phase complete.

tasks.title: Validation task with threshold rules
tasks.objective: Fail fast when a run looks abnormal so we don't poison the table.
guidance: thresholds.py: parsed_rows ≥ 0.5 × avg(last_5_runs); null_rate(price|location|title) ≤ 0.20; FK integrity listings.source_id → sources.id.
Returns structured result; failure raises ValidationError.
CLI: `validate run --run-id …`.
tests: unit tests for each threshold (pass/fail edges) using synthetic audit history
tasks.demo: Synthetic collapsed-row run → validate fails with explicit reason; healthy run passes.

tasks.title: Airflow setup + korean_rental_full_etl DAG
tasks.objective: Orchestrate the full pipeline on a 6-hour cadence with email notifications.
guidance: Add Airflow webserver + scheduler services to docker-compose.yml using LocalExecutor.
Airflow metadata DB separate from app DB.
dags/full_etl.py schedule '0 */6 * * *', tasks health_check → extract → transform → load → validate → notify via BashOperator/PythonOperator wrapping CLI.
Each task wraps audit.start_run/finish_run.
EmailOperator for success/failure notifications via SMTP from .env.
Conservative retry/backoff per task.
tests: tests/integration/full_etl_dag/test_dag_import.py runs `airflow dags test korean_rental_full_etl <date>` against test compose with fixtures
tasks.demo: `docker compose up`, trigger DAG in Airflow UI → all six tasks green; failure email lands in MailHog (dev SMTP sink).

tasks.title: Cleanup DAG + final docs/runbook
tasks.objective: Maintain the table over time and ship onboarding documentation.
guidance: dags/cleanup.py schedule '0 3 * * *', tasks mark_stale_listings_inactive (UPDATE is_active=false WHERE last_seen_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '14 days') and purge_old_raw_pages (DELETE WHERE fetched_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days').
.env.example, README.md (quickstart, architecture, troubleshooting), source-onboarding runbook.
`make smoke` runs `airflow dags test` for both DAGs.
Final coverage check ≥80% on transform/.
tests: integration test time-travels last_seen_at and fetched_at, runs cleanup, asserts correct rows flipped/purged
tasks.demo: Fresh-clone walkthrough — `cp .env.example .env && docker compose up -d && make smoke` green; cleanup DAG triggered manually shows correct stale/purge counts. Project complete.
